quotes.t: God is a fire that measures a cubit in height and breadth.
God is a fire that measures out and contains all things.
The universe is not a disorderly aggregation and a mere heap of things.
The universe itself is God.
The world is a god, a living being, the single one who is truly god and lord of many gods.
The world is a living being, endowed with soul and reason.
The world is a living being, for it is self-sufficient and self-sustaining.
The world is a living being, for it is the most excellent of all existing things.
The world is a single entity, comprehending all things within itself.
The world is not devoid of beauty.
The world is not devoid of design.
The world is not devoid of destiny.
The world is not devoid of divinity.
The world is not devoid of fate.
The world is not devoid of goodness.
The world is not devoid of justice.
The world is not devoid of meaning.
The world is not devoid of mind.
The world is not devoid of necessity.
The world is not devoid of order.
The world is not devoid of providence.
The world is not devoid of purpose.
The world is not devoid of reason.
The world is not devoid of significance.
The world is not devoid of truth.
The world is not devoid of value.
The world is not the product of a creator who is separate from it.
The world is not the work of a creator who is transcendent.
The world is not uncreated and imperishable, but it is eternal, indestructible, uncreated, and everlasting.
The world is not uncreated and ungoverned by providence.
The world-order is a reality, and not a mere name.
